summary: PASS on candidate 90ad5271 (d662625). All seven required commands pass, and prefreeze passes on a fresh clone with the tree clean and the ID unchanged. The independent suite has 86 tests: 85 pass (70 carried A24/A25 cases plus 15 new QA8 cases for F-DG0-132/133/011/222), and the single failure is the reproduction of the new Low finding. The QA8 cases fail 9/13 on the round-7 candidate, which shows the repairs are real. Register integrity, DG0 evidence content, agent-load evidence, agents.md-vs-evidence, the live guard probe, my own replayed-prompt transcript and A01-A28 feasibility all report 0 errors. F-DG0-222 is reproduced on e11b5f0 and fixed: CLOSED_VERIFIED. One new Low, non-mandatory finding, F-DG0-223: the F-DG0-133 regex (\S+) refuses genuine runs from a checkout path containing a space, and the runner doesn't reject such paths. It fails closed and doesn't affect this environment; I would accept it as an observation.
